plan.notes: QUARTER CREDIT HOURS: ABCO Technology is a quarter-system career college; the official catalog publishes every program in 'QUARTER CREDIT UNITS' (the course-table column is labeled 'Units'). All credit values in this plan are quarter credit hours, NOT semester credits. Source: official ABCO Technology 2026-2027 Catalog (effective July 1, 2026 - June 30, 2027), https://abcotechnology.edu/wp-content/uploads/2026/07/ABCO-TECHNOLOGY-catalog-2026-2027.pdf . Transcription verified against the catalog PDF layout extraction on 2026-09-30. Award: Diploma, A+ Certification. Program length: 5 weeks; 5 quarter credit units required. CT220's catalog-listed prerequisite is 'High School Diploma' (an admission requirement, not a course); no course prerequisites apply. The catalog publishes the complete course list without term subdivisions; the single term below presents the full program in catalog sequence.
